mapper.select: SELECT sc.id cart_id, sc.user_id, sc.product_id, sc.quantity, sc.selected, p.`name` product_name, p.cover product_cover, p.price, p.stock, p.`status` product_status FROM shopping_cart sc left join product p on sc.product_id = p.id where p.deleted = 0 and sc.user_id = #{userId}
select sc.product_id,p.stock,p.name product_name from shopping_cart sc,product p where sc.product_id = p.id and p.deleted = 0 and sc.id = #{cartId}
select product_id from shopping_cart where selected = 1 and user_id = #{userId}
